I've always been fascinated by the idea of locating the legendary Metal Library.

Im sure all of us have heard the legend and there maybe refrence in D&C and for sure the Journal of Discourses but the story goes that Moroni compiled the golden plates from a large metal library. Joseph later dreamed of its existence in addition to the Sword of Laban laying unsheathed on the table inside the cave (or at least thats what I learned in sunday school).

Anyway I was in a hotel watching Ancient Aliens and one of the guests mentioned the story of Enoch transcribing things he had learned from God, while on his space ship, to metal plates so the knowledge would not be lost. It sounds ridiculous I know, but the show had gotten my attention. The speaker then stated that there was a metal library in South America! He said it so nonchalantly I had to rework what he said in my head a couple of times.

With some reaserch turns out there are some claims of discovery down in Ecudor in a series of tunnels called the Tayos Caves. Many expeditions were sent include one funded by Mormons. Although no evidence of the library has come from these expeditions.

Here is a article that sums up the story of the Tayos Cave system and its Golden Library: http://www.philipcoppens.com/metal_libr.html

Another website with some books on the caves has anyone read them? http://www.goldlibrary.com/metal_library.html

As I mentioned before there is documentation on a Mormon expedition but I cant seem to find much on it other than it happened and they didnt find anything, does anyone have more information on it?

What do you guys think? Legit or fake? Nephite Library or some other culture? Im really interested in the discussion.
